decision_rule: Model-free owned HIP fixture loads pinned historical ggml HIP backend and allocates device memory. Require seven live source-bound PID/birth, executable, backend mapping, KFD device and positive own-VRAM snapshots over at least 12 seconds with captured-child cleanup. Stop on missing residency, identity or backend drift, compiler, STOP, deadline or cleanup failure. This does not qualify native gate, actual model, continuous residency, compute activity or inference.
